_comment: The only remote URL the new app may contain (D-027): the MF Screener navigation link. The build places it in one static <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"> in the navigation; no module may import this file (check-next fails on the URL anywhere else, including inside a script). No query string, no fragment, no credential.
